title: Grateful Dead Live at Manhattan Center on 1971-04-06
lineage: mono aud>?>7" reel @ 3.34 ips, dolby b technics rs-1506>teac an-180>hd-p2 24/96>hd>cd wave>adobe 2.0 16/44>flac

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality recording of a raunchy show with historic electric Oh Boy and Hog For You Baby, but incomplete second set and subpar sound
ai_review.review: The performance is noted for its raw energy – Pigpen’s rapped verses and a rare electric version of “Oh Boy” plus the only post‑1966 “Hog For You Baby.” However, the recording suffers from slight cuts, an incomplete second set and generally undesirable sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: One review gives a 3‑star rating, praising the band's raunchy energy but criticizing the incomplete set and poor audio; weighted blend of moderate show quality and below‑average recording yields ~2.8 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Songs are slightly cut, second set incomplete, overall sound less than desirable

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set includes rare electric Oh Boy; second set is incomplete, affecting overall flow
